units.source_text: "分明是做给我看的！"我突然想起来了。

en.t: It was clearly done for me to see! I suddenly remembered.
There could be no doubt about it.

units.source_text: 他知道我会经过这里，是为了让我看而那样的。

en.t: He knew I would pass through here, and he had done it that way so I would see it.

units.source_text: 老师非常明白自己的无力，最后才发现在这个世界上还有这种讽刺性的训诫方法，

en.t: The teacher understood his own powerlessness very well, and only at the end discovered that such an ironic method of admonition still existed in this world,

units.source_text: 那就是默默地撕碎我的心，唤起我的怜悯感情，最终使我屈服。

en.t: namely, to silently tear my heart apart, awaken my feelings of pity, and finally make me submit.
